en: Good morning, my name is Amina and I am the nurse today.
sw: Habari za asubuhi, jina langu ni Amina na mimi ni muuguzi leo.

en: What is your name?
Please sit down here.
I am going to ask you some questions about your health.
sw: Nitakuuliza maswali kadhaa kuhusu afya yako.

en: Is it okay if I examine you?
How old are you?
She is 34 years old.
The child is 5 years old.
Where do you live?
Do you have a phone number we can call?
sw: Je una namba ya simu tunayoweza kupiga?

en: What brings you to the clinic today?
How long have you had a fever?
sw: Umekuwa na homa kwa muda gani?

en: I have had a fever for 3 days.
Do you have a cough?
The cough started two weeks ago.
Do you have pain when you pass urine?
Where does it hurt?
The pain is in my lower belly.
Have you been vomiting?
He has vomited four times since this morning.
Does the child have diarrhoea?
The child is not breastfeeding well.
Is the child able to drink?
Has the child had any convulsions?
Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
I cannot sleep at night because of the pain.
sw: Siwezi kulala usiku kwa sababu ya maumivu.

en: Your temperature is 38.5 degrees.
Your blood pressure is 140/90.
The baby weighs 6 kg.
I am going to measure your blood pressure.
Have you been sick like this before?
Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
sw: Je una kisukari au shinikizo la damu la juu?

en: Have you been tested for HIV?
Is anyone at home sick with the same problem?
sw: Je kuna mtu nyumbani anayeugua tatizo hili hili?

en: Has the child received all vaccinations?
Are you pregnant?
When was your last menstrual period?
sw: Hedhi yako ya mwisho ilikuwa lini?

en: I am 7 months pregnant.
Have you had any bleeding?
Are you allergic to any medicine?
sw: Je una mzio wa dawa yoyote?

en: I am allergic to penicillin.
Are you taking any medicine now?
Take two tablets three times a day.
sw: Meza vidonge viwili mara tatu kwa siku.

en: Take one tablet every 8 hours for 5 days.
sw: Meza kidonge kimoja kila baada ya saa 8 kwa siku 5.

en: Give the child 5 ml of the syrup twice a day.
sw: Mpe mtoto ml 5 za dawa ya maji mara mbili kwa siku.

en: Take 500 mg of paracetamol when you have pain.
sw: Meza paracetamol mg 500 unapokuwa na maumivu.

en: Do not take more than 8 tablets in one day.
sw: Usimeze zaidi ya vidonge 8 kwa siku moja.

en: Finish all the medicine even if you feel better.
sw: Maliza dawa yote hata kama unajisikia vizuri.

en: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
sw: Usinywe pombe wakati unatumia dawa hii.

en: Take this medicine with food.
sw: Meza dawa hii pamoja na chakula.

en: Drink plenty of clean water.
Mix one sachet of ORS in one litre of clean water.
sw: Changanya pakiti moja ya ORS katika lita moja ya maji safi.

en: Keep the baby warm.
Continue breastfeeding the baby.
Come back immediately if the child cannot drink.
sw: Rudi mara moja ikiwa mtoto hawezi kunywa.

en: Come back if the fever lasts more than 2 days.
sw: Rudi ikiwa homa itaendelea zaidi ya siku 2.

en: Go to the hospital if there is heavy bleeding.
sw: Nenda hospitali ikiwa kuna kutokwa na damu nyingi.

en: Come back in one week.
Your next appointment is on 12 March.
sw: Miadi yako ijayo ni tarehe 12 Machi.

en: The clinic opens at 8:00 in the morning.
